purpose: The single controlling registry of per-route legal ratification. Both runtime structures are generated projections of this file: the evaluator's ratification Sets, and the compiled profiles' lawrenceRatification blocks. Neither is independently editable.
controllingAuthority: Lawrence (counsel). Runtime usage alone does not establish legal authority; this registry records counsel's decision and the runtime follows it.
whyThisExists: The repository carried two editable per-route ratification records that disagreed — 80 routes in the evaluator's ratified set, 53 in the compiled profiles, 40 in common. Route selection was made against the wrong one, and a route counsel holds to guidance was chosen as a build candidate. Two editable authorities is the defect; one registry with two generated projections is the fix.

statusVocabulary.ratified_deployable: Counsel confirmed the route is legally correct. Payment may open once the route is also source-ready, artifact-ready and Grade-A fulfillment proven.
statusVocabulary.corrected_awaiting_reconfirmation: Built with corrected wait, anchor and gates; counsel has not reconfirmed. Payment stays shut.
statusVocabulary.hard_gate_pending: A named substantive eligibility gate is not implemented in code. Promoting it would open payment on records the engine cannot screen.
statusVocabulary.held_guidance: Held to substantive guidance only. Not a packet route.
statusVocabulary.approved_release_guidance: Approved release behaviour for a guidance outcome. Not a paid packet.
statusVocabulary.stale_snapshot_only: Carried only by the compiled snapshot and by no counsel decision the evaluator records. It is listed here so it is visible, and it projects into nothing: not the evaluator's Sets and not the compiled block.

commercialRule: Ratification is necessary and never sufficient. Commercial fulfillment opens only when the route is legally ratified AND source-ready AND artifact-ready AND Grade-A fulfillment proven, with an open posture on its fulfillment record.
